title: Google\Cloud\Monitoring\V3\UptimeCheckIp
name: UptimeCheckIp
description: Contains the region, location, and list of IP addresses where checkers in the location run from.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.region
params.description: A broad region category in which the IP address is located.

params.name: data.location
params.description: A more specific location within the region that typically encodes a particular city/town/metro (and its containing state/province or country) within the broader umbrella region category.

params.name: data.ip_address
params.description: The IP address from which the Uptime check originates. This is a fully specified IP address (not an IP address range). Most IP addresses, as of this publication, are in IPv4 format; however, one should not rely on the IP addresses being in IPv4 format indefinitely, and should support interpreting this field in either IPv4 or IPv6 format.
